主要内容: On July 16, 2014, Optical Cable Corporation (OCC) declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.02 per share on its common stock, effective July 15, 2014. The dividend will be paid on or about August 15, 2014, to shareholders of record on July 29, 2014, implying an annual cash dividend of $0.08 per common share. The company has maintained a quarterly dividend since October 2010, reflecting its continued positive operating cash flow. Optical Cable Corp is a leading manufacturer of fiber optic and copper data communication cabling and connectivity solutions primarily for the enterprise market. Its product offerings include designs for commercial, enterprise network, datacenter, wireless, residential, and campus installations, as well as customized products for specialty applications and harsh environments such as military, industrial, mining, petrochemical, wireless carrier, and broadcast applications.
